Thiol and phosphonate functionality, hydrophobic trimethylsilyl-derived groups, and residual silanols; optional amines require separate APS variant.

Generic downstream coating recipe; not a separately identified Table 1/Table 2 physical batch. Siloxane shell is organic-functional and amorphous; no overall SiO2 stoichiometry or crystalline silica phase is assigned.

Unresolved information

  • Declared HRTEM/AFM SI not located or inspected.
  • No measured atomic coordinates, refined unit cell, CIF, SAED or XRD dataset supplied.
  • Color labels are cohort descriptions, not universal physical-batch identifiers across tables/figures.
  • Upstream core and ZnS shell recipes cited rather than reproduced.
  • TMAH solution concentration, first precipitation methanol amount, many agitation/ramp/pressure settings, isolated yield and final shell stoichiometry unreported.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Materials list 0.45 mm nylon filter vs Methods 0.45 µm; optional filtration sentence 0.22 mm vs repeated 0.22 µm routine filters. No silent normalization.
  • Methods rotary reduction 2–5× vs Discussion <4×; Discussion mentions Schlenk line alternative.
  • Methods 24 h after rotary and ≥12h after centrifugal before column; Discussion ~12 h between rotary and centrifugal stages. Preserve chronology conflict.
